_note: Fixed, published outlet list. Lean is never set by hand: each outlet's side is computed in code from the 'pew' numbers, copied exactly from Pew Research Center's News Media Tracker (survey of 9,482 U.S. adults, March 10-16, 2025): the % of Republicans/lean Republican and the % of Democrats/lean Democrat who regularly get news from the outlet. Outlets Pew did not ask about have no 'pew' entry and stay Unplaced. Add or remove outlets in the open, with a changelog entry.
